name: cockpit
description: Dashboard pane with live activity, usage meters, git and dev servers; plan band; clearer spinner and tool rows; chat-like transcript; alerts with one sound per kind; a matching color theme

notesDir.title: Notes folder
notesDir.description: Folder where the Learn tab appends the ★ Insight points as one Markdown note (for example the root of an Obsidian vault). Leave empty to keep them in the Learn tab only.

notesName.title: Note name
notesName.description: File name, without .md, of the note written in the notes folder.

obsidianVault.title: Obsidian vault name
obsidianVault.description: Name of the Obsidian vault that holds the notes folder. Set it to show an Obsidian button that opens the note; leave empty otherwise.
